search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 为连续函数，$D:x^2+y^2\leq x$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 的累次积分为[\quad] $\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}dy\int_{\frac{1-\sqrt{1-4y^2}}2}^{\frac{1+\sqrt{1-4y^2}}2}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^{1/2}dy\int_{\frac{1-\sqrt{1-4y^2}}2}^{\frac{1+\sqrt{1-4y^2}}2}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dx\int_{-\sqrt{x-x^2}}^{\sqrt{x-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dx\int_{-\sqrt{x^2-x}}^{\sqrt{x^2-x}}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_0^1dx\int_{-\sqrt{x-x^2}}^{\sqrt{x-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$，原式=$\int_0^{\frac{1}{2}}dy\int_{\frac{1-\sqrt{1-4y^2}}{2}}^{\frac{1+\sqrt{1-4y^2}}{2}}f(x,y)dx$。
